messages:
eli: Opening a small docs PR to reconcile the Supported Regions matrix and add a concise SDK v2 migration snippet for overriding regional endpoints. Also including a short 'data residency' caveat for hosted customers. Draft PR: #4231.

sam: Quick Q: do we want to show the env var approach or prefer passing base_url to the client constructor? I vote env var + direct param example.

eli: Same as other recent updates: show both. Keep JS and Python, but add a tiny shell export example for ops.

priya: Legal asked for stricter wording around residency. They provided this sentence to avoid accidental guarantees: "For hosted deployments, request metadata and transient artifacts may be processed in regional control planes. Customers requiring contractual data residency should contact their account representative or sales to discuss a Private deployment." Use verbatim.

eli: Adding that exact sentence.

frank: UX nit: the endpoints table header was changed last sprint which broke some anchors used across examples. Please include a redirect notice: "Legacy anchor #regions -> #supported-regions" and run link-check CI.

eli: Will add the redirect note and ensure the CI job includes an anchor check.

sam: Snippets I drafted below — default host uses canonical docs domain and caption text added:
```js
// JS
const endpoint = process.env.REGIONAL_ENDPOINT || 'api.redwood-inference.com';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: `https://${endpoint}` });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Summarize:' });
// Replace with your regional endpoint (see table above)
```

```py
# Python
import os
endpoint = os.getenv('REGIONAL_ENDPOINT', 'api.redwood-inference.com')
client = RedwoodClient(base_url=f"https://{endpoint}")
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt='Summarize:')
# Replace with your regional endpoint (see table above)
```

Shell one-liner: `export REGIONAL_ENDPOINT=sg-api.redwood-inference.com`

frank: Confirmed APAC endpoint name is `sg-api.redwood-inference.com`. Add a sample row in the table for APAC (Singapore) referencing that host. Also change table header text to 'Data residency (hosted)'.

eli: Done in the draft. @priya please quick-review the legal sentence in place.

priya: Approved with one micro change: change "Private deployment" -> "a Private deployment". Otherwise LGTM.

docs-bot: preview build: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4231/preview123. CI: link-check failed initially (old handbook link), build ok after fix, accessibility flags contrast on header.

sam: I fixed the handbook link and re-ran the link-check. All green now except the contrast warning.

frank: I'll open a small follow-up to tweak CSS for header contrast to meet AA. Not a blocker for content.

eli: Plan: merge after 1) legal quick-ack (done), 2) UX confirm (frank), 3) CI link-check passes. Will backport to `stable-docs-v1` after merge.

frank: UX sign-off given. Thanks everyone.

eli: Merging now. I'll open the backport PR and the CSS follow-up separately. Posting a short note in #product once backport merges. :white_check_mark:
